summary: Alvotech filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual and Extraordinary General Meeting held on June 3, 2026, where all draft resolutions were approved, and announcing the resubmission of Biologics License Applications (BLAs) to the U.S. FDA for AVT05 and AVT06, proposed biosimilars. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change. Both items are routine corporate governance and regulatory updates with no special-situation event disclosed.
